title: Barcelona to the Costa Brava
structure: W Barcelona (3 nights) → Costa Brava (2 nights) → Le Méridien Barcelona (1 night + departure)

days.label: Tue Aug 11
days.theme: Arrival, W Barcelona, Gothic Quarter & El Born

events.title: Arrive at BCN Airport
events.details: Allow 60–90 minutes for immigration, baggage claim, and leaving the terminal.

events.title: Taxi to W Barcelona
events.details: Go directly to W Barcelona, Plaça Rosa dels Vents, 1. Waterfront at the southern end of Barceloneta.

events.title: Arrive at W Barcelona
events.details: Drop luggage if room is not ready. Do not book any timed attraction for the first morning.

events.title: W Barcelona + Beachfront Walk
events.details: Walk along Sant Sebastià Beach → Barceloneta promenade. Light snack or drink. Low-stress first look at Barcelona.

events.title: Lunch in Barceloneta
events.details: First proper meal: seafood, croquetas, pan con tomate, grilled fish, tapas, rice dishes. Save the bigger paella for another night.

events.title: W Barcelona Reset
events.details: Room check-in, shower, nap, pool, beach, relax. The W is worth actually using.

events.title: Gothic Quarter
events.details: Taxi to Plaça Reial. Walk: Plaça Reial → Carrer del Call → Plaça Sant Jaume → Cathedral → Pont del Bisbe → Plaça del Rei → Temple of Augustus.

events.title: El Born
events.details: Santa Maria del Mar → Passeig del Born → Carrer de Montcada → surrounding side streets.

events.title: Dinner in El Born
events.details: Tapas-focused dinner. Better for the first evening meal than returning to the W.

events.title: Port Vell Evening Walk
events.details: Walk toward the harbor, then taxi back to the W.

events.title: W Barcelona
events.details: One drink at the hotel or enjoy the waterfront. Otherwise, sleep.

days.label: Wed Aug 12
days.theme: Sagrada Família, Passeig de Gràcia, Casa Batlló & Gràcia

events.title: Breakfast at W Barcelona
events.details: Fuel up for the main architecture day.

events.title: Taxi to Sagrada Família
events.details: Use taxis from the W rather than walking/metro for major sightseeing moves.

events.title: Sagrada Família
events.details: Book early entry. ~2 hours: main basilica, Nativity façade, Passion façade, museum, tower if desired. One of the signature experiences of the trip.

events.title: Avinguda de Gaudí
events.details: Walk toward Hospital de Sant Pau. See the exterior, stop for coffee. No need for another large interior tour.

events.title: Passeig de Gràcia
events.details: Taxi to Eixample. Walk past Casa Milà / La Pedrera → Passeig de Gràcia → Casa Batlló.

events.title: Casa Batlló
events.details: Tour Casa Batlló. Choose this over doing both Casa Batlló and Casa Milà interiors.

events.title: Lunch in Eixample
events.details: Proper sit-down lunch in the neighborhood.

events.title: Return to W Barcelona
events.details: Swim, pool, beach, nap, shower, relax. The W improves the trip by giving you this afternoon reset.

events.title: Gràcia
events.details: Taxi to Gràcia. Explore Plaça de la Vila de Gràcia → Plaça del Sol → Plaça de la Virreina. More residential Barcelona after a monument-heavy morning.

events.title: Dinner in Gràcia
events.details: Neighborhood dinner in Gràcia.

events.title: Return to W Barcelona
events.details: Evening drink at the W — no travel needed afterward.

days.label: Thu Aug 13
days.theme: Park Güell, Montjuïc, W Beach Afternoon & Barceloneta Evening

events.title: Breakfast at W
events.details: Last morning at the W before Costa Brava tomorrow.

events.title: Taxi to Park Güell
events.details: Head up to the park for early entry.

events.title: Park Güell
events.details: Monumental Zone, Hypostyle Room, serpentine mosaic bench, Gaudí structures, city viewpoints. ~90 minutes.

events.title: Gràcia Coffee
events.details: Come down from Park Güell. Coffee or snack in the neighborhood.

events.title: Lunch
events.details: Have lunch before crossing toward Montjuïc.

events.title: Montjuïc
events.details: Taxi to Montjuïc. MNAC viewpoint, Olympic area, gardens, miradors, skyline views. Do not try to walk the entire hill.

events.title: Return to W Barcelona
events.details: Intentionally earlier return. This is the transition from city sightseeing toward the coastal vacation.

events.title: W Barcelona Beach / Pool Afternoon
events.details: Proper chunk of afternoon enjoying the hotel: pool, beach, spa, drinks, waterfront walk. Major advantage of the W.

events.title: Barceloneta Walk
events.details: Walk from the W along beachfront: Sant Sebastià Beach → Barceloneta Beach → Barceloneta neighborhood.

events.title: Seafood Dinner
events.details: One of the main Barcelona dinners: grilled Mediterranean fish, gambas, croquetas, seafood rice, paella, fideuà. No crossing the city afterward.

events.title: Walk Back to W
events.details: Beachfront promenade back to the hotel. Last night at the W.

events.title: Breakfast
events.details: Final breakfast at the W.

events.title: Checkout from W Barcelona
events.details: Collect luggage and prepare to depart.

events.title: Pick Up Rental Car
events.details: Arrange pickup to avoid driving through central Barcelona. Load luggage and depart.

events.title: Drive to Begur
events.details: Head north toward Costa Brava. ~1.5–2 hours via AP-7.

events.title: Begur Arrival
events.details: Drop luggage at the Costa Brava hotel. Base yourself around Begur.

events.title: Aiguablava
events.details: Spend the core of the day at Cala Aiguablava: swimming, snorkeling, kayaking, paddleboarding, beach. Do not rush this.

events.title: Coastal Lunch
events.details: Long Mediterranean lunch overlooking or near the water.

events.title: Hotel / Siesta
events.details: Check in properly. Shower and relax.

events.title: Begur Old Town
events.details: Explore the old town. Walk toward Begur Castle as the temperature falls. Views across the Empordà and coastline.

events.title: Dinner in Begur
events.details: Evening meal in the village.

days.label: Sat Aug 15
days.theme: Calella de Palafrugell, Camí de Ronda, Llafranc, Pals & Peratallada

events.title: Breakfast
events.details: Start the day at the hotel.

events.title: Calella de Palafrugell
events.details: Port Bo, whitewashed waterfront buildings, small beaches, fishing-village streets.

events.title: Camí de Ronda
events.details: Walk the coastal path Calella → Llafranc. Rocky coastline, pine trees, turquoise water, coves. One of the highest-priority experiences of the entire trip.

events.title: Llafranc
events.details: Explore the marina and waterfront. Optional: continue toward Sant Sebastià lighthouse for views.

events.title: Long Seafood Lunch
events.details: Seafood in Llafranc or Calella: local fish, anchovies, prawns, seafood rice, fideuà.

events.title: Swim
events.details: Return to the water. Relax rather than immediately getting in the car.

events.title: Drive Inland
events.details: Head toward the medieval villages.

events.title: Pals
events.details: Explore the medieval center. Stone streets and viewpoints.

events.title: Peratallada
events.details: Walk through stone streets and plazas around golden hour.

events.title: Dinner
events.details: Eat in Peratallada or return toward Begur.

days.label: Sun Aug 16
days.theme: Costa Brava → Le Méridien, Relaxed Final Barcelona Day

events.title: Breakfast in Costa Brava
events.details: Final morning on the coast.

events.title: Leave for Barcelona
events.details: Drive south back to the city.

events.title: Return Rental Car
events.details: Drop the car, then head to Le Méridien Barcelona. Central location: walk directly into Gothic Quarter, La Rambla, Plaça Catalunya, Passeig de Gràcia.

events.title: Le Méridien Check-in
events.details: Drop bags. Different character from the W — central city positioning.

events.title: Central Barcelona Walk
events.details: Le Méridien → Plaça Catalunya → La Rambla → Gothic Quarter → Plaça Reial. Intentionally easy.

events.title: Lunch
events.details: Central Barcelona lunch.

events.title: Le Méridien Break
events.details: Relax. Organize bags. Use the hotel.

events.title: Flexible Final Barcelona Block
events.details: Choose what you enjoyed most: A) Shopping on Passeig de Gràcia, B) El Born boutiques/cafés, C) Gothic Quarter revisit, D) Palau de la Música, E) Port Vell sunset. Do NOT choose another beach afternoon.

events.title: Farewell Dinner
events.details: Make this the best or most celebratory dinner of the trip.

events.title: Final Barcelona Walk
events.details: Walk back through the center to Le Méridien.

events.title: Breakfast
events.details: No rush. Final morning.

events.title: Final Walk
events.details: Option A: Le Méridien → Gothic Quarter → Plaça Reial → La Rambla → back. Option B: Plaça Catalunya → Rambla de Catalunya → Passeig de Gràcia → back. Coffee, pastries, souvenirs, photos.

events.title: Back to Le Méridien
events.details: Finish packing. Collect luggage.

events.title: Checkout / Airport Transfer
events.details: Leave based on flight time. Target arrival at BCN ~3 hours before international departure.
